confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Zurich's price level, not checked against live menus, hotel listings, or booking sites. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and district; July is high season. FX: 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 came from search snippets that reported the RBA table. I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Zurich's known position among the highest-cost cities in Europe, benchmarked against other high-price Swiss and Nordic cities such as Geneva, Oslo and Copenhagen. No live-price comparison was performed.
